prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent inventory ICON ATLAS, strict 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid of SIXTEEN isolated objects in row-major order on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048. Equal invisible cells, each object centred at 70% cell size with wide clear gutters. Hand-painted watercolor/gouache for a cozy cottage game: earthy muted colors, gently wobbly warm charcoal-brown contour, tiny worn material detail, soft paper tooth, clear silhouette at 64 px. Transparent background, no white paper, no cast shadows, no labels, writing, grid, numerals, circles, die-cut borders, plastic, vector icons, photos or glossy 3D. Entire complete object inside each cell. Exact objects, row-major:
1: a complete cord necklace with a small golden-brown ACORN pendant.
2: a complete fine cord necklace with one pale blue DEWDROP-shaped glass pendant.
3: a complete green braided cord necklace with a small carved wood HEART pendant and leaf.
4: a complete thin cord necklace with one delicate GREEN LEAF pendant.
5: a complete silver-chain necklace with a pale lavender-blue moonstone pendant.
6: a complete delicate DAISY flower circlet with cream petals, honey centres and green stems.
7: a complete circlet of overlapping small fresh green LEAVES.
8: a small delicate gold crescent MOON CROWN circlet with three tiny star decorations.
9: a pair of simple small warm copper hoop earrings.
10: a pair of tiny turquoise MUSHROOM-shaped pendant earrings, no external halo.
11: a pair of delicate gold hoop earrings.
12: a pair of small pearl drop earrings with fine gold hooks.
13: a short rustic worn wooden garden fence section with two posts and two rails, little moss at the base.
14: a short crooked weathered wood garden post with a small hanging warm amber lantern and tiny green climbing leaves.
15: a tiny friendly garden scarecrow in a straw hat, patched honey-brown shirt and blue neckerchief on a wood cross, no ground.
16: a compact construction kit: a tiny folded red-brown wood barn facade, a bundle of timber planks tied with rope and a rolled blank blueprint, clearly a building kit.
